text: Stored in `tenant_module_settings` with a `_`-prefixed key (e.g. `_module_enabled`, `_installed_submodules`). - **Automatically stripped** by `getModuleSettings()` — code consuming settings via that function will never see them. - **Never accessed directly** by module business logic; only via dedicated kernel APIs (`isModuleEnabled()`, `_cmsGetRegisteredSubModules()`, etc.).
